//: Marks the main-process sources as CommonJS. desktop/package.json declares "type": "module" for the Vite renderer, and under Node16 module resolution TypeScript reads the NEAREST package.json to decide a file's module kind. Without this file every electron/*.ts would be treated as ESM and tsc would demand a .js extension on every relative import. Mirrors the {"type":"commonjs"} that scripts/build-electron-main.mjs already writes into dist-electron.
